lock_snapshot.global_database_and_big_lock_observation: Only shared READ locks listed for the selected known database/big-lock files; these are not presumed stale
lock_snapshot.limit: Current lock snapshots cannot identify the daemon operation from the completed client trace

limits: Shared pool headroom is not reserved build capacity
ONLINE/healthy status is not a latency or sufficient-space guarantee

declared_gc_thresholds.inference: [INFERENCE] Available capacity below min-free can trigger automatic GC under normal settings; it does not prove that GC caused the completed client wait

guarded_operator_handoff.read_scope: Only proc metadata and kernel stacks for exact held-lock owners; no FD target data, environment values, ptrace or process control
guards: Exact PID, UID, parent, process start ticks and command
Exact device/inode held FLOCK WRITE row
Before/after owner and lock revalidation; changed targets are skipped with payload discarded
limits: Before/after validation is observational, not an atomic snapshot
Changed owners must not be replaced automatically

missing_prerequisite: Operator authentication for the approved root-owned process metadata reads, or the guarded reader JSON produced by an authenticated operator
decision: Stop privileged inspection at the authentication boundary. Do not rerun acceptance, change GC settings, delete shared data or signal any lock owner.
non_claims: No privileged kernel-stack or FD facts obtained
No passing acceptance or lifecycle completion
